title: Ghost Line summary.json
description: Overall race counts, per-pair ride verdicts, and the list of every race today wins.

definition.description: Human-readable description of the race parameters, e.g. the slider range and photo-finish band.

races.description: Total number of races across all pairs.

wins_1938.description: Number of races won by the 1938 trolley.

wins_today.description: Number of races won by today's bus.

photo_finishes.description: Number of races decided within the 1.0-minute photo-finish band.

ride_same.description: Number of pairs whose ride verdict is 'same'.

ride_faster_today.description: Number of pairs where today's ride is faster.

ride_slower_today.description: Number of pairs where today's ride is slower.

pairs_without_one_seat_ride.description: Number of pairs for which no one-seat trip was found at the configured radius.

today_wins.description: Every individual race where today wins, one entry per race minute.

margin.description: Margin of victory in minutes (always positive; the loser's total minus the winner's total).
